content: Hey please tell me what is my responsibilities in HomeFlo project?

Welcome to the HomeFlo project! As a Student, your specific responsibilities may vary based on your role and the tasks assigned to you. Generally, students in project environments like HomeFlo may be involved in the following activities:

📋 Responsibilities in HomeFlo Project
Learning and Development:

Familiarize yourself with the project goals, methodologies, and tools used by the team.
Participate in training sessions or workshops to enhance your skills relevant to the project.
Assisting Team Members:

Support other team members with their tasks, which may include research, documentation, or testing.
Collaborate with peers on specific assignments or group projects.
Participating in Meetings:

Attend team meetings, including daily scrums, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
Contribute ideas and feedback during discussions to help improve project outcomes.
Documentation:

Help maintain project documentation, including notes from meetings, updates on tasks, and progress reports.
Ensure that all documentation is clear and accessible to team members.
Hands-on Tasks:

Depending on your skills and interests, you may be involved in coding, testing, or designing aspects of the HomeFlo application.
Work on assigned tasks in Jira, ensuring that you follow the project’s Scrum methodology.
Feedback and Improvement:

Provide feedback on processes and suggest improvements based on your observations.
Engage in discussions about user experience and functionality from a student perspective.
🗣️ Project-Specific Inquiries
For more detailed or specific inquiries about your role, I recommend reaching out to Yuliia Zviahintseva, the Project Manager of HomeFlo. She can provide you with tailored guidance based on your current assignments and expectations.

Feel free to ask if you have any other questions or need further clarification!
